entry.content: API GatewayFeatureCall Google Cloud APIs from streaming gatewaysStreaming gateways can now call Google Cloud APIs such as aiplatform.googleapis.com. A gateway with an effectiveStreamingMode of EFFECTIVE_STREAMING_MODE_ENABLED authenticates to backends whose host ends in .googleapis.com or .vertexai.goog with an access token for the gateway's service account. entry.summary: Google SecOpsFeatureBasic Mode searchThis feature is in public preview. The SIEM Search page now provides two search-execution modes: Basic Mode and Advanced Mode. Basic Mode (the default option) uses
entry.content: Google SecOpsFeatureBasic Mode searchThis feature is in public preview. The SIEM Search page now provides two search-execution modes: Basic Mode and Advanced Mode. Basic Mode (the default option) uses a streamlined, fast-path execution pipeline that bypasses secondary enrichment steps during search execution.
